entities.summary: Mining Boom and Contemporary Challenges, a transformative movement in Mongolia (1996–2025). Emerged from Democratic Revolution of 1990 and Peaceful democratic revolution — Mongolia adopts a new constitution. Catalyzed Oyu Tolgoi agreement signed — one of the world's largest copper-gold mines and Mongolia hosts the first-ever papal visit to the country by Pope Francis.
